title: Wikidata
citation: Wikidata, retrieved via Wikidata Query Service (SPARQL); raw snapshot in data/raw/.
reliability_note: Community-edited; broad coverage and stable identifiers, but uneven quality: some P17 'country' values are historical polities, some links are wrong (e.g. Lalibela churches tagged 'Eastern Orthodoxy'), dates often lack references. Treated as a secondary aggregator, not an authority.

title: English Wikipedia
license: CC BY-SA 4.0 (text); facts are not copyrightable, text is not copied into GeoChronos
citation: English Wikipedia article, cited by title and revision id in each claim's evidence.
reliability_note: Tertiary source. Used in the POC to verify dates and to locate the underlying scholarly literature it cites; claims resting only on Wikipedia are marked confidence 'medium' and should be upgraded to primary/secondary literature.

title: UNESCO World Heritage List
citation: UNESCO World Heritage Centre, World Heritage List, property page by reference number.
reliability_note: Authoritative for inscription status, property boundaries and official descriptions. In the POC the property IDs come via Wikidata P757; property pages returned HTTP 403 to automated fetching on 2026-10-01, so UNESCO text was not machine-verified.

title: Pleiades: A Gazetteer of Past Places
publisher: Institute for the Study of the Ancient World (NYU) and Ancient World Mapping Center (UNC)
license: CC BY 3.0 (verified 2026-10-01 on https://pleiades.stoa.org/downloads and /credits; credit AWMC and ISAW)
citation: Pleiades place resource, by Pleiades ID (obtained via Wikidata P1584).
reliability_note: Scholarly gazetteer focused on the ancient Mediterranean and Near East. Night run 2026-10-01: historical names (with language codes) and representative points imported, mapped only via Wikidata P1584; points used for QA only.

title: GeoChronos POC editorial curation
citation: Classification or structuring decision made by the GeoChronos curator while building the POC seed.
reliability_note: Used ONLY for modelling decisions (facet assignments such as form/function, historical-region membership, hierarchy links) and never as the sole support for a date or coordinate. Claims resting only on this source carry status 'needs_verification' unless they are definitional.
